answer: A screenshot can be faked in an afternoon; a decade cannot. A Tide gauge reader record with hydrographic office attestation works because tides the office logged from one harbour for nine years, and the issuer holds the original. The lantern is the original itself — the farm holds only copies of copies. The plume is the renewal audit, where the issuer re-checks the file instead of trusting it, and the vertex is the decade the farm must rent, year by year, before it can even apply.
